message:
Giveaway: 3x Barrows dyes, 3x Divert codices, plus a bonus Malevolent kiteshield (sorry for the ROTS spam earlier!). You can sign up for anything, but if you win double, your 'lowest' prize will be rerolled. Can only win once. 

We have had multiple people asking if they could donate to the giveaway month and you can! Contact Zweb or Collectordog!\

DogBot: Reaction roles are now handled by Dogbot (hosted by our own members, should always work).

Good luck on the next give-away and look forward to the first winner being anounced tomorrow (last weeks grimoire giveaway)!
